main_text.head: Lectoribus Cupidis, Candidis, benevolis.
main_text.p: Eandem obsequor desiderio vestro Polyhistores, & qui estis Philopatrides, & conatus meos de Clivia, Julia, Montibus, Geldria, Marca, Ravensburgia antiquis & modernis vobis sacro. In his de provinciarum harum ortu, progressu, & auctu, rebus etiam, inter & apud gentes illas à Dynastis, Comitibus, Ducibus earundem gestis, diligenter investigo: idque non ex fabulis & lacunis mythologicis, sed veris classicisque auctoribus & manuscriptis authenticis; operâ Hermanni Ewichii Clivo-Wesalii, in veteri Clivia Julio-Montia concinnandâ adiutus. Annales autem voco, tum quia ad res patriæ scriptorum penuriâ pene obliteratas, hæc appellatio ob collationem historiarum exterarum aptissima est, & dum ejusdem ætatis acta conjungit, aberrare lectorem cognoscendi avidum non patitur; tum quia exempla virtutum & vitiorum consimilia suppeditando ad prudentiam civilem confert plurimum. Quid assecutus sim, vos Lectores Cupidi, candidi, benevoli judicate & studio meo, atque in patriam communem affectui, utinam effectui dato, adspirate.
M. Wernherus Teschenmacher ab Erverfelt Montanus.

page.notes: Faint show-through from the reverse page is present in the lower half and not transcribed. Catchword "Histo-" read at lower right; the upper-right "Histo-" printed as a catchword. Page number not visible. Initial "E" is a decorated woodcut initial, transcribed as "Eandem". Printed hyphen in "Polyhistores" and "Histo-" is as seen; the text "Quid" and "vos" carry printed Renaissance spellings, left unchanged. Mark on "Ravensburgia" is unclear and may need checking.
